entities.summary: Goedele Maria Gertrude Liekens is a Belgian politician, sexologist, TV host and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss Belgium 1986 and represented her country at Miss Universe 1986. She also currently serving as a member of the Belgian Chamber of Representatives for Anders, to which she was elected in 2019.
